work.title: Brandenburg Concerto No. 5 in D major

version.note: The performing edition and continuo realisation are not identified. The 1871 Bach-Gesellschaft score is used for commentary, not attributed to the performers.

performers.note: The upstream programme confirms all three soloists. In the Affettuoso file’s Author field Goldstein is accidentally repeated as harpsichordist; its Description and the upstream programme both name Ganong. No conductor is credited. The slow movement uses only the three soloists.

date.note: The upstream programme lists 10 and 17 February 2008. Neither source assigns this track to one concert day; the month is retained rather than guessing a day.

place.note: The consulted file page and programme do not identify a recording venue; the ensemble’s home location is not a session location.

label.note: Pandora/ibiblio and the Al Goldstein collection are the digital repository and collection, not an established original record label.

catalogue.note: No original carrier catalogue number is supplied.

matrixTakeSides.note: No matrix, take, side or original session-medium identification is supplied; the digital file alone does not establish that such identifiers are inapplicable.

credits.note: Al Goldstein is credited as collection source, not explicitly as recording or mastering engineer. The Commons uploader is not treated as transfer engineer.

date.note: The November 2008 Commons upload date is not a transfer or session date.

processing.value: Ogg Vorbis source; MP3 access derivative supplied by Wikimedia Commons.
processing.note: Embedded metadata names Xiph.Org libVorbis I 20020717. Original capture medium, editing and mastering are not documented; no no-edit claim is made.

digital.format: MP3 access derivative; uploaded source Ogg Vorbis

composition.value: Underlying composition is public domain under ordinary life-plus-70 terms.
composition.note: Bach died in 1750; this does not clear an unidentified modern edition.
